🚀 Understand-Anything | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To help developers quickly understand and navigate large or unfamiliar codebases by visualizing them as interactive knowledge graphs.
✨ Key Features: • Interactive knowledge graph visualization of codebases • Exploration, search, and querying of code structure • Integration with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, etc.)
📖 Summary: Understand Anything transforms codebases into interactive knowledge graphs, allowing developers to explore, search, and understand complex projects more effectively. It integrates with various AI coding assistants to provide a visual overview of code structure and dependencies.
